paths._logo_comment: Relative to this folder. Point it at C:\\Users\\ahiya\\Desktop\\RushPoint-logo\\<file> to use the master logo.

fonts._comment: DECISION PENDING (see README). The brief asks for Space Grotesk / Inter / JetBrains Mono only, but Space Grotesk and Inter contain NO Hebrew glyphs, so Hebrew would fall back to Arial. The app's real design system (packages/brand/tokens.mjs) is Rubik (display) + Assistant (body) + JetBrains Mono (codes). Defaults below follow the app. To switch, change these names; every renderer reads them from here.

money._rate_comment: ILS per 1 USD. Update on edit day (Bank of Israel representative rate). The receipt's dollar line renders TODO until this is a number.
